releaseNotes:
## Downloads

- macOS 14 or later, Apple Silicon: signed, notarized, stapled Developer ID installer. Existing fork builds can update from the app.
- This release ships only the macOS installer. The previous [Windows x64 release](https://github.com/thuongtin/crossdesk/releases/tag/v1.7.7-1-20261124) remains available.
- Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify the downloads.

## Changes

- Adds an H.265 option for desktop connections, with hardware codec support on macOS through VideoToolbox and Windows through Media Foundation where supported.
- Adds low-load encoding for new desktop connections and reduces capture overhead.
- The source also includes Windows H.265 and service-pipe fixes. This tag has no newly built Windows installer.
- Keeps Postcard, DeskHub and the fork update channel. The default signaling endpoint remains `crossdesk.ecom.io.vn:9099`.
